summary: AKTIUM HOLDING AS (org. no. 996 311 759) is a private limited company (AS) based in Fredrikstad, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2010-12-20. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.110 (Kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 293 130 and net income was NOK 5.4 m. CEO: Tore Johan Arntzen; board chair: Tore Bjørsvik; auditor: ØST-REVISJON AS. Also: LEI 894500SP039XVED8C656.
